verdict.rationale: Built-in AI for operations is a fair question for a banking platform, but the evidence describes only REST APIs, SDKs, payment products, approval flows and automated reconciliation. Nothing shows native natural-language transaction search, drafted dispute or alert responses, or anomaly summaries. The llms.txt file makes the docs readable by external AI tools and is not an AI feature of the product itself.

support.subject: As an ops user, the product ships its own AI for banking operations — natural-language search over transactions, drafted responses to disputes and alerts, anomaly summaries — built in, not bolted on
